facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates about 3 live commercial (third-party colocation) data centre facilities in Congo in 2025, with about 1 MW live critical IT load, about 60% occupied by third-party customers, and all commercial capacity controlled by telecoms providers; the facilities are not named.

systems.owner: State of Congo with AfDB financing; built by Sumec

note: Only the first fact is stated; the brief names no facility, gives no tier rating and says nothing on a live cloud region.
